pla-01.prompt: Flat two-dimensional educational illustration. Simple closed shapes, clear dark outlines, completely solid uniform fills. No gradients, shading or texture. A woman in green invites a woman in purple to sit at a small round table: the host extends a clear open palm toward an empty chair while looking at the approaching guest. Two plain mugs on the table, all full people, simple shoes and complete furniture. Compact centered scene. No words, numbers, speech bubbles, invitation cards or logos. Single square CACE vocabulary image. Pure white background. Show every subject and essential prop whole inside the middle two thirds of the canvas. Zoom OUT, leave one sixth of canvas width empty at both sides, generous white above and below. Natural anatomically correct hands. Plain shoes and clothing. No border. Absolutely no text, writing, letters, numbers, labels, brand marks, emblems, logos or watermarks anywhere.
